verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents opening and scanning mail in its own access-controlled facilities, with high-resolution scans and digital copies stored in the cloud. That shows contents are scanned, not just envelopes photographed. The evidence never mentions searchable/OCR PDF output or any stated scanning turnaround. Missing for 10: searchable PDF/OCR output, stated same- or next-business-day scan turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration.
